verdict.rationale: INPI's own docs say applicants and holders have representatives (mandatários) whose details they can update, so a delegated-representative role exists. Nothing in the evidence publishes what that representative may or may not do on the holder's behalf. Missing for 10: published authorization/power-of-attorney forms, defined roles and scope of representative actions, rules on which signatures or acts must stay personal to the holder, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal

citations.quote: Os titulares ou requerentes de direitos de propriedade industrial podem atualizar gratuitamente os dados dos seus mandatários
